question.en: Which cross-cutting instruments operate across macro works?

summary.en: Six instruments, each with its own evidence status.

text.en: Practical assessment and credential records. Enforcement is proposed, not verified: no competency levels are published yet.
Directives, reports, approvals and a Friday lock. Designed; not yet operating for any paid team.
Dashboards read rollups_daily, never raw rows. Implemented in this release (bin/rollup.php).
Five percent of submitted weekly reports are re-reviewed independently. Fixed by the licence doctrine; not configurable in the UI.
Identity and credential verification layer. Concept only; no audit or implementation is published.
Internal documentation and analysis assistance with human review. Concept only; no autonomous credential award.
